claims.text: The 8 November Xiaomi Android 15 capture shows the dark-mode Markets screen with public CoinGecko reference data; it is a debug-session image, not standalone release proof.
The 10 November Xiaomi Shop screenshot visibly presents USD prices, Channel3-reported stock, starred advertised commission rates and retailer actions; its values are historical.

The 11 November local website review showed United States · USD, a maximum price filter of $150 and 24 search results, with prices visible on the cards; the review is textual and no current screenshot is included.
A real merchant checkout and an agent-controlled spendable wallet are not demonstrated in this edition.

credits: New landscape and square illustrations were generated with OpenAI image_gen through Codex on 11 November 2026; both were visually reviewed without pixel edits.
The project team supplied the unchanged native Android screenshots; older captures retain their original dates and scopes.
PayPal, Venmo, retailers and product makers retain their respective identities; this concept does not claim trademark rights, affiliation or endorsement.
limitations: Independent PayPal concept. No official affiliation, endorsement or trademark licence is claimed.
Product prices, reported stock and advertised commission rates can change. The native Shop screenshot is a dated point-in-time view and does not prove retailer inventory or a successful handoff.

The 11 November local web review is a written observation only; no screenshot was saved into this pack. The results included a generic/global retailer domain, so the US/USD storefront does not guarantee domestic shipping or seller eligibility.
The standalone Android release update and app launch were not verified on device; the Android captures are earlier debug-session evidence.
No live merchant checkout, payment, customer wallet access, spendable agent wallet, PYUSD transaction, subscription action, customer data, or internal PayPal reporting is established.
Channel3 checkout was listed as coming soon when its developer page was reviewed on 11 November 2026; product discovery and retailer handoff do not prove in-app payment.
Market values and AI commentary are reference material, not PayPal execution pricing or financial advice.
